The typical floor stands for levels 5 to 8; other floors differ: levels 2
one-bedroom, 2 studio; levels 10 to 12, 8 one-bedroom, 4 studio.
Stairs drawn with their treads and exit doors; a switchback stair's flights
either side of its divider, a scissor stair's two flights crossed; the
arrow is the entry from the street.
Each home is a block of its area: in a shallow strip it runs long along the
facade, where a design would turn the corner.
Egress (BC Building Code 2024, Part 3; figures to be verified): dashed, the
farthest unit door to its exit along the corridor;
